---
title: "A relative R_LIBS breaks as soon as R runs in a subfolder"
ref: ENV-02
categories: [OS and CI]
impact: cryptique
attendu: "the same library, whatever the working directory"
versions: "All"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2024)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```yaml
# .gitlab-ci.yml
variables:
  R_LIBS: "ci/lib"

render:
  script:
    - Rscript -e 'install.packages("rmarkdown")'
    - quarto render reports/summary.qmd
```
:::

This pitfall depends on a CI pipeline, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

A relative path in `R_LIBS` is resolved from the working directory of the R process, at the moment it starts. The installation runs from the root of the repository, into `ci/lib`. But `quarto render` runs the document in a new R process started from `reports/`, which then looks for `reports/ci/lib`. That folder does not exist, and R drops it from `.libPaths()` without a warning: the packages simply cannot be found.

## The remedy

Build an absolute path from the variable provided by the CI.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```yaml
variables:
  R_LIBS: "${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/ci/lib"
```
:::
